review_candidates.title: Sr. Software Engineer – Command & Control (C2)
review_candidates.description: 🚀 Hiring: Senior Software Engineer – Command & Control (C2) Must be a U.S. citizen and eligible to obtain a security clearance. An active clearance is not required. Evona is partnered with a growing space technology company that is transforming how satellite fleets are operated through modern software. We’re searching for a Senior Software Engineer to develop the low-level Command & Control software connecting its platform to a wide variety of spacecraft. This is not high-level mission orchestration. The engineer will build the actual ground-to-vehicle communication layer—formatting commands, transmitting them through ground-based RF systems, receiving telemetry and ensuring different spacecraft can communicate reliably with one unified platform. Prior aerospace experience is valuable, but it is not required. We are also interested in engineers from telecommunications, wireless systems, networking, robotics, autonomous vehicles, IoT, industrial automation and other industries involving communication with physical hardware. What we’re looking for: • Approximately 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent technical depth • Strong Python development skills; Rust experience is valuable • Experience building software that communicates with remote machines, embedded devices, radios, vehicles or other physical systems • Hands-on experience implementing machine-to-machine communication protocols • Knowledge of binary serialization, encoding, packetization, framing, transport, sequencing, acknowledgements, error handling or state management • Experience taking a protocol or interface specification through implementation, testing, troubleshooting and production operation • Ability to explain the complete journey of information from one physical system to another • Strong systems thinking and comfort solving ambiguous hardware/software integration problems Experience with satellite telemetry and commanding, TT&C, CCSDS, CSP, CFDP, XTCE or MIB is highly valuable—but not essential. Kubernetes, DevSecOps, encryption, relational databases and time-series databases are additional advantages. 📍 Denver, Colorado 🏢 Hybrid—approximately two days per week onsite 💰 Expected base salary: $155,000–$190,000, subject to final confirmation If you’ve built software that communicates with complex, remote or intermittently connected systems—even outside aerospace—I’d love to speak with you. #SoftwareEngineering #SpaceJobs #Aerospace #CommandAndControl #Python #Rust #EmbeddedSystems #DistributedSystems #SatelliteTechnology #Hiring

review_candidates.title: NC3 Sr Advanced Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, or related Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 years relevant experience. CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS: Department of Defense Top Secret security clearance is required at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required. Responsibilities For This Position ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES: As a software engineer for the NC3 business segment, you’ll be a member of a cross functional team responsible for design, development and test of the next generation of Strategic Systems. We encourage you to apply if you have any of these preferred skills or experiences: Object oriented development Agile experience SASTs tools GitLab Python and bash Understanding of SW engineering concepts Atlassian Good communication skills particularly with outside customer What sets you apart: Strong understanding of software development process, as well as software engineering concepts, principles, and theories Creative thinker capable of applying new information quickly to solve challenging problems Comfortable providing technical leadership Team player who thrives in collaborative environments and revels in team success Commitment to ongoing professional development for yourself and others Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation Our Commitment to You: An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development. Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule) Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more See more at gdmissionsystems.com/careers/why-work-for-us/benefits Workplace Options: This position is fully on-site. While on-site, you will be a part of the Dedham, MA location. Target salary range: USD $157,397.00/Yr. - USD $174,613.00/Yr. This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled. Company Overview General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team! Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans
